ImGuizmo 1.89 WIP (2024)
https://github.com/CedricGuillemet/ImGuizmo

ImGuizmo.cpp, ImGuizmo.h and LICENSE alone: the gizmo the editor's viewport
moves, turns and scales entities with. Copied from the old engine's deps
(bubble0.7) as it was first added there, before its one local change.
Dropped: GraphEditor, ImCurveEdit, ImGradient, ImSequencer, ImZoomSlider,
the example and the build files.
